1 .  At the request of learned advocate for the petitioner, leave to add MMARDA as a party.
2.
The petitioner's claim to be tenants of the writ property.
The writ property is acquired and award is already passed in respect of the writ property.
The compensation is offered to the owner.
3. The acquisition it appears is for the purpose of laying down metro line and for the purpose of ingress and egress of the fire vehicles.

sentences.text: Under the order dated 7/1/2023, the Court had asked Diksha Rane 901. wp 2261-21.doc the respondent nos. 1 to 3 to indicate whether hearing was granted to the petitioner before making the award and whether as on date, the respondent nos.1 to 3 have taken the possession of the writ property and if taken, whether they require the plot for the purpose for which the land was acquired or any other public purpose or not.
5. It is submitted that on 6/3/2023, the notice has been issued by the MMRDA for dispossession of the occupants.
6. In fact, the petition ought to have been filed against the MMRDA as the MMRDA is acquiring body.
7. Leave to add MMRDA is granted.
Amendment to be carried out forthwith.
8. Petitioner still to explain about the rights of the tenants.

One of the submission of learned advocate for the petitioner is that the acquisition proceeding is at the behest of the owner and the property which is situated adjacent to the Metro Line is not acquired, even though it belongs to the same owner.
9.
Issue notice to the respondent nos.4, 5 and added party, returnable on 21/3/2023.
Hamdast allowed.
10. Till next date, if further act pursuant to the notice Diksha Rane 901.
wp 2261-21.doc dated 6/3/2023 has not been taken, then status-quo as on today to be maintained.
11. At the request of learned counsel for the petitioner, leave to file additional affidavit is granted.
12. Re-verification is dispensed with.
13. The parties to act on an authenticated copy of this order.

(SANDEEP V. MARNE, J.) (ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE)
